customManagers.description: govulncheck pin in ci.yml's env: block — invisible to the github-actions manager, which only reads uses: refs, not env: values.

The canonical-guard checkout in ci.yml pins go-kure/.github by SHA in `ref:`, invisible to the github-actions manager. Without this the vendored guard is byte-compared against a stale revision (go-kure/kure#689).

external-secrets' /apis submodule has no semver tags, so the gomod manager (disabled below) can only see main HEAD. Track the *release* upstream_release is pinned to instead, so a PR opens when upstream cuts a release rather than on every commit. Upstream interleaves vX.Y.Z and helm-chart-X.Y.Z release tags; the matching packageRules entry below (extractVersion is a packageRules-only field, invalid directly inside a customManagers object) filters to the former only.

packageRules.description: external-secrets' /apis submodule is untagged, so the gomod manager's @latest is upstream main HEAD -- every commit reads as a new version (go-kure/kure's release-pinning plan). Disable the raw gomod bump; the customManager above tracks upstream_release instead and re-pins via sync-eso-pin.sh.

barman-cloud's version is set by minimum-version selection from plugin-barman-cloud's own go.mod, not by an independent choice -- upstream pins it by pseudo-version, so every upstream commit reads as a new digest and the shared preset's go-patch rule automerges it unreviewed (go-kure/kure#688 merged in 11 minutes). Disable the standalone gomod bump; postUpdateOptions gomodTidy re-raises the require whenever the plugin bump lands, which is the update path that should exist.

Filter the github-releases datasource to plain vX.Y.Z tags only (extractVersion, undocumented as a customManagers field, applies as a packageRules match here instead) -- upstream also cuts non-matching helm-chart-X.Y.Z tags, which must never satisfy this dependency. Then re-pin external-secrets to the new release's commit, regenerate go.mod/go.sum and versions.yaml's upstream_release_commit, and regenerate docs/compatibility.md, pkg/versions/versions_gen.go and go.mod's pin comment (via sync-versions.sh generate), on the customManager's own branch whenever upstream_release bumps.

Keep go.mod's go directive AND versions.yaml's go.current in sync with mise.toml's go pin (sync-go-version.sh, checked by make check-go-version and by sync-versions.sh check's validate_gomod respectively), keep golangci-lint's Makefile/ci.yml/docs pins in sync with mise.toml (sync-tool-versions.sh), then regenerate docs/compatibility.md and pkg/versions/versions_gen.go (the published Go API's generated data, sync-versions.sh generate) from the now-current versions.yaml + go.mod, on the bot's own branch after any gomod or mise bump. sync-go-version.sh must run FIRST: generate emits versions.yaml's go.current verbatim into both generated artifacts (never go.mod directly), so generating before that field is updated would leave both one step stale even once go.mod itself was fixed — a mise-only Go bump originally left go.mod (and versions.yaml) behind with no postUpgradeTasks command to fix either, and CI's validate job fails on drift for any of these (go-kure/kure#734). mise.toml is the only copy the mise datasource actually bumps. Dependabot could not run this step, which left its PRs permanently red (#665, #667). All three scripts are no-ops when nothing derived changes, so matching both managers is safe. go.mod and versions.yaml are both included in fileFilters because generate also rewrites go.mod's `// Current pin:` comment from the k8s.io/api replace directive, and sync-go-version.sh rewrites go.mod's go directive on line 3 and versions.yaml's go.current.

Fold the go-kure/.github ref: customManager dependency into the same group as the github-actions uses: bump (shared.json's own github-actions group only matches matchManagers: ["github-actions"]), and re-vendor scripts/check-forbidden-terms.sh whenever it moves.

Flux minors are capped at the current series, preserving the intent of the retired Dependabot ignore rules: a fluxcd minor moves supported_range and the API surface together (see versions.yaml notes) and must be a deliberate coordinated upgrade, not a bot proposal. Dashboard-gated rather than disabled so the pending series stays visible. Majors are already gated org-wide by the shared preset.

Keep docs/github-workflows.md's govulncheck version mentions in sync with the GOVULNCHECK_VERSION pin the customManager above bumps in ci.yml. Scoped to that customManager specifically, not just by depName: golang.org/x/vuln is also a real go.mod dependency, and without matchManagers a gomod-sourced bump of it would match here too — postUpgradeTasks has no merge semantics, so this rule's commands would silently replace the gomod/mise rule's ./scripts/sync-versions.sh generate, reintroducing the compatibility-matrix drift that rule exists to prevent.
